title: A traumatized Area 51 worker saw reptilian beings in a basement

tellings.quote: they have a friend who worked at Area 51 or might be a friend of a friend but they met him and he was totally traumatized

plain: A man who worked at Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in Nevada, is said to have seen reptile-like beings in a basement there and to have come away deeply shaken. Michels repeats it as something told to him by a couple named Garrett McNamara and Nicole McNamara, who said they met the man, possibly a friend of a friend, and that "he was totally traumatized." If true, it would mean non-human beings were kept at the base.
